steps.title: Upgrade the savings vault, and set USDC as the one token it accepts
steps.explanation: Moves the savings vault to its audited code. The same call names USDC as the only token it accepts, so deposits and redemptions never stop between the two. Call 1 of 3, in order.

steps.title: Give the savings relayer the savings vault's RELAYER_ROLE

steps.title: Take the savings vault's OPERATOR_ROLE away from the savings relayer
steps.explanation: The old operator role let the relayer key do more than relay; it is taken away (audit H-3). Call 3 of 3, in order.

steps.title: Post the month's floor inputs (coverage cap $10,000.00): Assurance signer 1
steps.explanation: Sets how much the Credit Backstop may pay Clear Lending on a draw (the coverage cap), with the month's timing shortfall and attested covered book. Until both signers post the same figures the cap is $0 and every draw is refused; deposits and member grants don't need it. No timelock: it applies as soon as the second signer sends it. Re-post each month.

steps.title: Give the payout top-up wallet the PayoutPool's FUNDER_ROLE (day 0, before I2)
steps.explanation: Lets the top-up wallet fund the PayoutPool (fund pulls the wallet's own USDC), and nothing else. Send it before the credit handover (I2): until then the deployer holds the PayoutPool's admin; afterwards the grant is a 7-day credit timelock proposal. The wallet never calls withdrawCapital (decision 51).

steps.title: CL Operating: enable Safe's AllowanceModule
steps.explanation: Lets CL Operating give one wallet a spending limit. The module (Safe's audited AllowanceModule v0.1.1, 0xAA46724893dedD72658219405185Fb0Fc91e091C) moves CL Operating's money only for a delegate CL Operating names, within the limit CL Operating sets for it. CL Operating's only owner is the Clear Lending Safe (2 of 2): in the Safe app open CL Operating, load the batch in Transaction Builder, confirm it from the Clear Lending Safe (a nested-Safe confirmation, both owners), then execute. Sign all three at once: safe-batches/signing-TU-cl-operating-setup.json (written while they are ready).
